Brief review 2026-09-20 (BÄVER IBC-Tanköverdraget) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. The hook `Passar den min tank?` fails the three-question test: a question cannot be true or false. Next version: lead with the measurement as the headline (`120 × 100 × 116 cm. Passar en standard 1000 L IBC-tank.`) and move the doubt into the sub-line, or drop it.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
